Pick up to 7 wizards and see which effects they provide together, and who provides them. It shows what is recorded; it does not rank or recommend teams.

    What the selection provides

    Pick wizards to see their effects here.

    Effects are shown as recorded for each wizard's skills. Conditions are listed as written and are not checked against the rest of the team. Basic damage and transformations are not listed. Lacrima effects are listed under the wizard wearing them. Your picks are kept in the page address: bookmark or share it to keep them.
